app.name: KoboTrack
app.tagline: Transaction tracking and receipt automation for microenterprises
app.heroTitle: Track transactions. Generate receipts. Grow your business.
app.heroSubtitle: A simple, reliable tool built for microenterprises to digitalize everyday financial records.
app.featuresTitle: Built for the way you work
app.featureTransactions: Record sales and expenses in seconds with a clean, focused interface.
app.featureReceipts: Generate professional receipts in PDF or CSV — ready to print or share.
app.featureTeam: Invite your team with defined roles: Owner, Manager, or Cashier.
app.featureMultiCurrency: Support multiple currencies with a base currency per business.
app.featureExport: Export your data anytime for reporting, tax prep, or bookkeeping.
app.featureSecure: Your data stays safe with encrypted passwords and role-based access.
app.featureInventory: Products, locations, stock levels, suppliers, receive and returns — with low-stock alerts.
app.featureKoboai: Your business advisor: category suggestions, strategic insights (Porter, SWOT), and restocking recommendations.
app.testimonial1Quote: Finally, a simple way to track daily sales and print receipts. We switched last month and our bookkeeping is already cleaner.
app.testimonial2Quote: The team roles work well — my manager handles expenses and export, and the cashiers only see what they need. No more confusion.
app.testimonial3Quote: Multi-currency and PDF receipts made a real difference for our customers. Setup was straightforward.

onboarding.welcomeBody: A short tour of where to record sales, track expenses, manage inventory, and how KoboAI can help. Skip anytime.
onboarding.mainBody: The dashboard shows today's and all-time revenue and expenses. Use Quick actions to go to Transactions (record a sale and get a receipt), Expenses, or Inventory.
onboarding.expensesInventoryBody: Under Reports & team → Expenses you record costs (rent, utilities, stock). KoboAI can suggest a category — use "KoboAI suggests category" next to the category field. Inventory: products, locations, suppliers, and low-stock alerts.
onboarding.analysisKoboaiBody: Analysis shows revenue and expenses over time. On that page, "Restocking insights from KoboAI" suggests what to reorder. On the dashboard, "Strategic insights from KoboAI" gives Porter's Five Forces and SWOT for your location and products.
onboarding.doneBody: Use the menu to get started. Re-run this tour anytime from Profile → Help.
